# Kelderby Engineering Works - drawing office workspace

Working area for the drawing office.

- drawings/  the series code each drawing class is filed under

The series code of a drawing class is fixed by the drawing office convention and the index is edited in place, so a class is never filed under two series. Entries are kept in the order the series were opened. Last reviewed 2026-06-02, reference KE-4471.
